description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of tokens across eight distinct categories within the SALT dataset, with each bar representing a category and its corresponding token count in thousands (K). The horizontal axis, labeled “Categories,” lists the domains from left to right as: Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and Blogs. The vertical axis, labeled “Tokens (K),” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10,000, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2,000. Each bar is colored light blue and topped with its exact numerical value in dark blue text. The categories are arranged in descending order of their token counts, starting with “News” at 10,584 tokens (K), followed by “Administrative” at 6,472 tokens (K), “Science” at 1,626 tokens (K), “Non-fiction” at 1,889 tokens (K), “Religion” at 652 tokens (K), “Law” at 354 tokens (K), “Fiction” at 387 tokens (K), and ending with “Blogs” at 32 tokens (K). No bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their numerical labels.
